crossRefs.note: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og…
(For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t…
For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave…
For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land…
Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out…

people.name: Ashtaroth
people.line: A city of Og, king of Bashan.

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Edrei
people.line: Amorite city defeated by Moses and the Israelites

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

people.name: Rephaim
people.line: A race of giants who inhabited Canaan

translations.web: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.
translations.bsb: the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and had remained as a remnant of the Rephaim. Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them,
translations.kjv: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
translations.asv: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (the same was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for these did Moses smite, and drove them out.
